existing_coverage.overlap_note: MENA round 7 contains one Spain reference row for the Order of Isabella the Catholic breast star; it is outside this military-awards batch and is not treated as a new family here.

sources.source_name: BOE — Real Decreto 1040/2003, Reglamento general de recompensas militares
sources.date_coverage: Regulation dated 2003-08-01; historical reward systems are described in its legal recitals and articles.
sources.content_coverage: Downloaded the complete BOE HTML and all 39 annex PNG files (figures 001–039). Figure 001 is only the Pantone palette; figures 002–039 were inspected as official design plates. This batch crops 40 complete design elements from figures 002–039, splitting the three branch insignia from figure 015. The annex is fully swept; Spain's complete military-award universe is not.
sources.image_quality_notes: Official legal diagrams, largely monochrome. Colors for 2003 designs must be read from captions/text and the separate Pantone palette, not inferred from grayscale. No specimen photographs.
sources.download_method: BOE HTML image links downloaded directly; original image plates preserved under assets/raw/spain_boe_2003/.
sources.coverage_result: Supports the official 2003 design of the War Cross, Army/Naval/Air Medals, and Military/Naval/Aeronautical Merit Crosses with four distinctions and two formats. San Fernando, San Hermenegildo, constancy awards and other separate regulations need their own source batches.
sources.rights_note: Official legal instrument and annex diagrams; Spanish Intellectual Property Act, RDL 1/1996, article 13 excludes laws/regulations and corresponding official acts. Preserve BOE attribution and source-page linkage.
sources.notes: Figure numbers and crop rectangles are in assets/images/spain_military_batch1/images_manifest.json. The source-page annex caption states that the figures show decorations, insignia and ribbon bars.

sources.source_name: BOE — Real Decreto 336/2018, Medalla de Campaña
sources.content_coverage: Complete six-page decree downloaded; page 6 design plate rendered at 600 dpi. Crop includes complete obverse, reverse, ribbon and operation bars/clasps; full PDF and full-page render are retained.
sources.image_quality_notes: Official colored diagram, not a specimen photograph. The image shows the 2018 design and the illustrated operation-clasp arrangement; later changes after 2024 are not covered by this image.
sources.download_method: Direct PDF download and local page render/crop.
sources.coverage_result: One family and the 2018 official drawing variant are supported; the 2024+ drawing/design requires another primary source.
sources.rights_note: Official legal instrument and official figure; retain BOE attribution and exact source-page citation.
sources.notes: The plate is titled as the design of the decoration, operation rectangles and clasps for the campaign medal. Crop bbox is recorded in the image manifest.

sources.source_name: BOE — Las órdenes y condecoraciones militares del Reino de España
sources.date_coverage: Modern official reference volume; includes historic and current Spanish military awards.
sources.content_coverage: 285-page PDF downloaded and reviewed for structure; military awards begin in chapter 4 around p. 60, with separate chapters on San Fernando, San Hermenegildo, discontinued decorations, Guardia Civil and Military Ordinariate.
sources.image_quality_notes: Illustrated catalog; images not cropped into this batch due to the book's CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 notice and possible underlying third-party rights.
sources.download_method: Direct PDF download; full file retained for research.
sources.coverage_result: Useful as a source map and cross-check; chapter-by-chapter family/variant sweep remains.
sources.rights_note: PDF p. 6 states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; no book illustration is included in this deliverable.

sources.source_name: Antonio Prieto Barrio — current Spanish medal/order directory
sources.date_coverage: Current and recent Spanish awards; index lists 38 topic pages.
sources.content_coverage: Index and first 20 of 38 linked pages cached and swept; current military and civil awards are represented through the Orden del Mérito de la Guardia Civil. Eighteen topic pages remain.
sources.image_quality_notes: Small linked images and details are copyright-reserved; used as a research/name/design lead only, not published or counted as formal images.
sources.download_method: Index link traversal; cached HTML snapshots and raw candidate JSONL.
sources.rights_note: © Antonio Prieto Barrio, all rights reserved as displayed on page; no publication/reuse license inferred.
sources.notes: Strong date/name/regulation clues; every included fact still cites the governing official law where available.

sources.source_name: Wikimedia Commons — Spanish military decorations categories and file pages
sources.content_coverage: Four category endpoints attempted before HTTP 429; two standalone SVG file downloads were cached before the limit. No more requests were made after 429; no Commons item is counted in this package.
sources.image_quality_notes: Existing SVGs are complete official-style drawings; this package instead uses primary BOE figures. Category tree is not exhausted.
sources.download_method: Commons API/category traversal; paused at rate limit.
sources.coverage_result: Partial category sweep, rate-limited; continue only after the access condition changes or use an alternate route.
sources.rights_note: Per-file license metadata must be checked before use; the two cached files are excluded from this batch.
sources.notes: The four exact category endpoints attempted are not yet reconstructed in the local matrix; do not invent a base URL or repeat 429 requests.
